projects.title: Projects
projects.text: This is Projects, your filing cabinet. Every job the crew has done for you is a record in here, read straight from disk. Open one to see where it stopped and what it handed back. Copy resume puts the pick-up prompt on your clipboard: paste it to Claude and the crew carries on. New project starts a fresh piece of work. New brand sets up a second business.

new-project.title: New project
new-project.text: A new project is a drawer the crew opens for one piece of work. Give it a short name, say what it should deliver and who it is for, pick the brand, and add a deadline if there is one. Press Generate, then Copy, and paste the prompt to Claude. The crew creates the drawer itself, and it appears here the next time you reload.

new-brand.title: New brand
new-brand.text: One cabinet holds one active brand at a time. Working for a different business? Type its name and paste its website. Claude reads the site first: colours, fonts, logo, products, and how the business sounds, so everything the crew builds looks like them. Copy the prompt, paste it to Claude, answer a few short questions, and the new brand becomes the active one. Your current brand's projects are parked safely in their own drawer.
